Claims FAQ

Answers to the questions our claims desk hears most often.

How do I open a claim?

Call the claims desk or write to claims@example.com. Have your policy number ready.

How long does a payment take?

Approved claims are paid within ten business days. You will get an email when the transfer leaves.

What documents should I send?

  • Photos of the damage.
  • Receipts for anything you replaced.
  • A police report number for a theft.

Harbor Lane Mutual is a fictional company used in examples.
